components.text:
Circle: medium circle, ritual chalk.

Calls the moon-crowned Alpha to the edge of the circle. Beat it before dawn to win a spark of your own.
Only a werewolf Beta or Omega in beast form, at or above the server's trial level (10 by default), can try it. Nobody else may stand on the centre.
If your path to True Alpha is still open, winning would end it for good: you are asked first, and the rite starts only once you answer (within 2 minutes).
Needs a full moon: the moon must be full (phase 0) between dusk and dawn, in the Overworld. An eclipse counts too. The hub's moon calendar shows when the next one rises.

Moonstone: craft it from an amethyst shard and a silver ingot, in any order.

Needs the Werewolves mod.
